DeepCool AG400 LED CPU Cooler – High-Performance Cooling with RGB Lighting | otech.com.bd

Achieve superior cooling for your PC with the DeepCool AG400 LED CPU Cooler, available now at otech.com.bd. Designed to provide exceptional thermal performance and visually stunning RGB lighting, this cooler is perfect for gamers, PC builders, and anyone who demands both style and reliability in their system.

Key Features:

  • Efficient Heat Dissipation: Featuring 4 heat pipes and a 120mm fan, the AG400 delivers rapid heat transfer to keep your CPU running cool during demanding tasks, ensuring optimal performance.
  • Customizable RGB LED Lighting: Stand out with dynamic RGB LED lighting that can be adjusted to match your build’s aesthetics, with support for popular motherboard sync technologies (like ASUS Aura Sync, MSI Mystic Light, and others).
  • Whisper-Quiet Operation: The AG400's fan operates with minimal noise, providing effective cooling without disturbing your gaming or working environment.
  • Broad Compatibility: Designed for easy installation, the AG400 is compatible with a wide range of Intel and AMD sockets.
  • Durable and Reliable: Built with high-quality materials, this cooler ensures longevity and consistent cooling performance.

Specifications:

  • Socket Compatibility: Intel: LGA 115x, LGA 1200, LGA 1366, LGA 1700, LGA 2011, LGA 2066

                                                    AMD: AM4, AM3+, AM3, FM2+, FM2, FM1

  • Fan Dimensions: 120 x 120 x 25 mm
  • Fan Speed: 500-1800 RPM ±10%
  • Airflow: 62.7 CFM (Cubic Feet per Minute)
  • Static Pressure: 2.1 mmAq
  • Noise Level: 19.8 – 27.6 dB(A)
  • LED Type: RGB LED
  • Heat Pipes: 4 copper heat pipes
  • Heat Sink Dimensions: 121 x 79 x 158 mm
  • Fan Connector: 4-pin PWM
  • Weight: 675g

Why Choose DeepCool AG400 LED?

Exceptional Cooling Efficiency: The 4 heat pipes and 120mm fan ensure rapid heat dissipation, keeping your CPU temperatures low and performance high.

Customizable RGB Lighting: Tailor your PC’s aesthetic with vibrant RGB lighting that can be synced with your motherboard.

Quiet Performance: Enjoy silent operation even during high-load activities like gaming and video editing.

Wide Compatibility: The AG400 is compatible with both Intel and AMD sockets, making it a versatile choice for various system builds.

Get the DeepCool AG400 LED CPU Cooler today at otech.com.bd for unbeatable cooling performance, customizable RGB lighting, and quiet operation—ideal for your gaming rig or high-performance workstation.
